grammar.label: future continuous
grammar.meaning: an action in progress at a future moment

explanation.en: Use will be + -ing for what will already be happening at a future time: 'This time tomorrow I'll be flying.'
explanation.uz: Kelajakdagi ma'lum bir paytda davom etayotgan ish uchun will be + -ing: 'This time tomorrow I'll be flying.'

grammar.positive_example: This time next week I will be working in Almaty.
grammar.negative_example: This time next week I will work in Almaty all day long.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbekchada kelasi zamon bitta shaklga ega; davomiylik alohida belgilanmaydi.

grammar.label: future perfect
grammar.meaning: an action completed before a future point

explanation.en: Use will have + past participle for what will be finished by a future time: 'By June I will have finished.'
explanation.uz: Kelajakdagi ma'lum paytga qadar tugaydigan ish uchun will have + III shakl: 'By June I will have finished.'

grammar.positive_example: By Friday I will have written the whole report.
grammar.negative_example: By Friday I will write the whole report already.

l1_notes.uz: 'by' + vaqt bilan birga ishlatilishi tabiiy; 'until' emas.

body.text: It is. This time next year I will be working somewhere, I hope.

body.text: You will. What is your target?

body.speaker: Sarah
